department: Data Science, Ph.D. (School of Computing with School of Business)

deadline.value: The preferred Ph.D. deadline for Fall is January 15, so applying by then gives the best chance of funding consideration. The page gives no year, so 2027 is inferred.

gre_general.value: The Data Science PhD requires a competitive GRE or GMAT score.
gre_general.quote: A competitive GRE or GMAT score (required)

gre_subject.value: Data Science has no subject test on the page.

supervisor.value: The Data Science pages say students work with a faculty mentor but do not say whether a supervisor must agree before admission.

funding.value: Stevens funds a limited number of PhD students through assistantships and fellowships, awarded on merit.
funding.quote: Limited in number, these highly competitive opportunities are awarded to exceptional candidates based on merit

entry_route.value: A master's in a technical discipline is a requirement, though outstanding applicants with a bachelor's degree will be considered.
entry_route.quote: A master’s program in a technical discipline is a requirement for the program, although outstanding candidates with bachelor’s degrees will be considered, as well

notes: The Computing page says applications must be submitted by February 1 for admission the following fall; the Business page is the second school's description. The graduate deadline of January 15 is the earlier date and is used.
